newsitem.title: USA: C-TEC, Boston Edison in $300 mln deal - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: C-TEC, Boston Edison in $300 mln deal - WSJ.

text.p: C-TEC Corp and Boston Edison Co are expected to announce Monday that they have reached an agreement to invest a total of $300 million in an interactive data network for households in the Boston area, the Wall Street Journal reported.

Citing unidentified sources it described as being close to the deal, the newspaper said Monday Boston Edison would form a joint venture with the RCN unit of C-TEC to invest in the network over three or five years.
RCN would cover about 51 percent of the money and Edison the remaining amount, it said.
The project would be based on an existing 200-mile-ring of fiber-optic cable used for the utility's internal communications system, it added.
The newspaper said the partnership would sell local and long-distance telephone and video services and Internet access, among other things.
